description: Notification service WebSocket handler registers an event listener on each connection but never removes it on disconnect. Thousands of stale listeners accumulate causing memory bloat and eventual crash.

known_root_cause.description: WebSocket connection handler calls emitter.on('message', handler) for each new connection but never calls emitter.off() on disconnect. After 4,000+ connections, the EventEmitter holds thousands of live handler references, each retaining closure scope. Memory grows until OOM restart.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: deploy-notif-019 leaks event listeners on WebSocket disconnect — emitter.off() not called, 4000+ stale handlers accumulate causing repeated OOM restarts

logs.message: Deployment deploy-notif-019 complete. WebSocket push notifications enabled.
EventEmitter: possible memory leak detected — 12 listeners added for event 'message'. MaxListeners: 10.
EventEmitter warning repeated for 88 events. Listener count growing on each WebSocket connection.
Memory usage: 890MB. Listener count: 1,440. WebSocket connections since restart: 1,440 (0 removed on disconnect).
Memory usage: 1.4GB. Each retained handler closure holds ~350KB of scope data.
Memory usage 2.1GB. GC struggling to reclaim. Retained listener references prevent GC of closed connection scopes.
OOM Kill. Pod notification-service-4c8b2 terminated. Restart 1/5.
Pod restarted. Memory: 260MB. WebSocket connections re-establishing.
OOM Kill again. Pod notification-service-4c8b2 terminated. Restart 2/5. Listeners accumulated to 2,100 in 34 minutes.
OOM Kill. Restart 3/5. CrashLoopBackOff pattern forming.
Process restarts: 5 in last 3 hours. Datadog alert firing: process_restarts_total=5 > threshold=2.
notification-service unavailable. Real-time notification delivery failing for all connected clients.
